integrity: The theorem includes an all-orders elementary combinatorial proof. Direct original-graph exhaustion, an independent rung-word enumeration, and gap-graph distance/median tests were reproduced; finite tests are not a proof of all orders. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: This result concerns all fixed-cardinality maximal independent sets of labelled open two-row ladders under domination-preserving token sliding. It does not include circular ladders or token addition/removal; the known unweighted count is explicitly credited.
title: All-cardinality token-slide geometry of independent dominating sets on open ladders
